digest.component_or_area: ticket state schema and write surfaces
propositions: Add two new ticket state fields: `bridge_project` (tri-state string) and `repos` (list of strings) to schema and reducer with CREATE/EDIT event projection.
Implement create-time `--bridge-project` and `--repos` arguments on all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) that seed both fields into CREATE event data.

Add edit-time `--bridge-project` and `--repos` flags to the shared `edit_core` with a promote-only guard that refuses `bridge_project` changes on bound tickets but allows all edits on unbound tickets.
The promote-only guard consults `bindings.json` via `_load_binding_reverse` to determine whether a ticket holds a pre-existing binding and enforces the edit restriction.
Distinguish three states of `bridge_project` after replay: absent (legacy/unset), explicit empty string (never sync), and a key value (sync to project).
Defer inbound defaulting of `repos` from project mapping to a separate multi-project inbound-fetch deliverable and omit tracker-driven field population from this scope.
